review_notes: Read the whole file and the relevant definitions/lemmas in RealScalar.lean (the *_affine lemmas), LineRestriction/Basic.lean (lineRestriction) and searched the directory for an existing affine line-restriction lemma (none found). The strongest repeated block is the `hfun` computation, which appears three times verbatim. Other near-duplicates are the estimate/quotient pairs, which are mostly short wrappers or structurally parallel statements on distinct predicates; I did not report them, because a shared helper would not clearly meet the rubric's bar. I did not compile any rewrite, so the proposed lemma and its uses are unverified.

findings.problem: The same identification of the restriction of an affine function `y ↦ ⟪p, y⟫ + c` to the line `t ↦ x + t • v` as the affine scalar function `t ↦ ⟪p, v⟫ * t + (⟪p, x⟫ + c)` is re-proved verbatim, with the same simp set and `ring` step, in three theorems (lines 56-61, 70-75, 86-91). The three proofs then differ only in which `*_affine` lemma they feed it to. If the `lineRestriction` definition or the simp normal form changes, three copies must be repaired, and the `simp ... ring` script is fragile.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma before line 51:
```lean
theorem lineRestriction_inner_add_const (p x v : E) (c : ℝ) :
    lineRestriction (fun y : E => inner ℝ p y + c) x v =
      fun t : ℝ => inner ℝ p v * t + (inner ℝ p x + c) := by
  funext t
  simp [lineRestriction, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
  ring
```
Proof sketch: unfold the line restriction at `x + t • v`, expand the inner product additively and use real-linearity in the second argument, then close by commutative-ring normalisation. Then rewrite the three uses. `mem_directionalLineScalarEstimateSet_inner_add_const` becomes `by simpa [directionalLineScalarEstimateSet, lineRestriction_inner_add_const] using realScalarQuadraticEstimateAt_affine (inner ℝ p v) (inner ℝ p x + c) 0`. The quotient version is the same with `directionalLineScalarQuotientEstimateSet` and `realScalarQuadraticQuotientEstimateAt_affine`. `realScalarQuadraticEstimateWithDataAt_lineRestriction_inner_add_const` becomes `by rw [lineRestriction_inner_add_const]; exact realScalarQuadraticEstimateWithDataAt_affine (inner ℝ p v) (inner ℝ p x + c) 0`. The hypotheses are unchanged (`E` a real inner product space; `p v x : E`, `c : ℝ`) and the imports are already available. The lemma may also be marked `@[simp]` if it does not disturb existing simp sets; I have not checked this.
findings.benefit: The affine line-restriction computation is stated and proved once, each of the three consumers shrinks to a one-line use of the appropriate `*_affine` lemma, and the lemma can be reused by other files that restrict affine ambient functions to lines.
